title: Battle of Legendra
author: jl2l
selftext:
Another AI rules prototype I was working on this one has about 35+ iterations on it mostly with Opus 5.5 lots of cool details and emergent behaviors, runs in a determistic simulation.

Based on classic Sega Saturn game Dragon Force.

Be sure you change the settings; night with thunderstorms looks pretty cool.

Voxel walls that destruct.  
Commanders have there own behaviors lots of options, equippment.

3 Factions

Prototype Campaign mode is turn based you can mange your generals and castles.  
Sandbox to mess around with gameplay.

If there is any interest i plan on developing this into a Unity URP game with better VFX and artwork.

Trailer [https://youtu.be/3DE3gmzBNvU](https://youtu.be/3DE3gmzBNvU)
